title: Anyone ever check this title out?

posts.author: ASimpleShrine550
posts.body:
This is a documentary about The Making of Aurion by Kiro'o games
which goes to show how they started as a fan made project for the love of games turned into a passion money project
which I found a copy of their lost RPG Maker XP project.
oui.
It's a masterpiece to witness this.
Did you know last year they actually had a physical remaster for the Xbox? That's a big upgrade from a indie game from RPG Maker to Steam then Xbox!
Great job for some gamers with big dreams coming humbly out of Cameroon doing it right.
Just this goes to show that yes, RPG Maker with the right team, fun, hard work, can actually make commercially viable games of their own originality.
[Though it's modern incarnation is different than it's RM2k3 and RMXP era games first made, but its still a powerful testimonial to the origins that give this engine life. Hope this inspires many of you.]
